The recent loss of starboard hull component materials has placed Yazel Ahuatan in a precarious position. So that none may have cause to doubt his ableness, recover the materials his courier abandoned when attacked by Ixal in Treespeak.

Visit the crafting facility at Treespeak Stables, and present the component materials to Nellemond, so that you may use the facilities to construct the requisite components.

You have handed over the component materials to Nellemond, and gained access to the crafting facility. Synthesize two starboard hull components, and deliver them to Yazel Ahuatan at Ehcatl.

entries.en: The squa-hawk which echoes throughout Ehcatl is one of ultimate relief, as Yazel Ahuatan's comrades no longer have cause to doubt his competence. Maintaining an image as an able Ixal can be difficult at times, but the adulation of Ixali maidens more than justifies the effort─or so Yazel Ahuatan would doubtless say, if the question were put to him.
entries.fr: Vous avez apporté à Yazel Ahuatan <frnoun(Item,2,　8093,2,1)> dont il avait besoin. D'après lui, ses congénères du site de déboisement ixal ne sont pas près d'arrêter leurs agissements néfastes. Aidez les Planeurs d'Ehcatl à mener à bien leur projet malgré tout.

entries.en: Your crafting endeavor was a success? Then you must waste no time in returning to your client. Ah, and should something unfortunate befall your commission─accidental loss, theft, act of primal─you always have the option of retrieving from me the remaining materials and trying again!
entries.fr: Vous avez fini, si je ne m'abuse. Dans ce cas, il ne vous reste plus qu'à aller livrer votre commanditaire. En cas de perte, mettez-moi au courant et je verrai ce que je peux faire. Bonne route<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
仕事はお済みのようですから、納品に行くとよいでしょう。
製作した品を紛失するなどして、
再度この施設を使用したいときは、私にお申し出ください。

entries.en: Squa-hawk! Safe, my reputation is! To featherless <if(gnum4,craftswoman,craftsman)>, much and more is owed!

entries.fr: Oooh... Que <if(gnum4,celle-là,celui-là)> me pardonne. C'est du travail de pro<->fes<->sion<->nel, foi de celui-ci<nbsp>!

……これは、見事な出来ばえッェ！　恩に着るわッァ！
親方とに、どこまでもついていくわッァ！

entries.en: Rejoin the ranks of the buzzards, I wish not to do. Much more beloved by maidens, Yazel is, as able revolutionary!
entries.fr: Quant à ces satanés faux frères du site de déboisement... Quand arrêteront-ils de mettre des bâtons dans les roues de ceux-ci<nbsp>!? Celui-ci ne les laissera pas briser le rêve des Planeurs d'Ehcatl<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
それにしても伐採所の連中めッェ……
卑怯な嫌がらせをしやがってッェ！
あんな連中に、親方の夢を邪魔させてなるもんかッァー！
